provenance.label: Representative synthetic data
provenance.description: 720 fictional responses with deliberately constructed topic mixtures and contextual feature variation. Not real participant responses or original Strategy Connect analysis.
provenance.method: Synthetic topic mixtures and coded context features, mapped by a fixed linear projection. Four topic weights use an orthonormal simplex projection; three context features add local variation. Group labels follow the dominant synthetic topic; mixed and outlying perspectives remain visible. This is not a learned semantic embedding or a statistical finding.
provenance.projection: Illustrative seven-feature projection; global distance and visual density are not evidence of real consensus.
provenance.formation: Optional arrival motion is a visual illustration, not an algorithm replay.
